ability.rotp_ab.item_invisibility.desc: Toggle the visibility of the held item.
ability.rotp_ab.blood_splash.desc: Scatter blood to reveal an invisible presence.
ability.rotp_ab.active_invisibility.desc: Launch a rune that weakens and obscures its target.
ability.rotp_ab.ghost_mode.desc: Hold to enter a noclip spectator state.
ability.rotp_ab.perfect_invisibility.des: Hide completely, or crouch to hide a nearby target.
ability.rotp_ab.grant_invisibility.desc: Launch a rune that grants invisibility and beneficial effects.
rotp_ab.message.no_target: Aim at a living target within 6 blocks.
